name: TensorForge — CPU Mini Inference Engine with Graph Fusion + INT8 Quantization
machine_tag: Apple Silicon Mac (arm64), single thread, clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 (Apple clang 21)
dataset: real MNIST (SHA-256 checksummed download, storage.googleapis.com/cvdf-datasets/mnist); NOT synthetic
honest_findings: Fusion gave no meaningful wall-clock speedup (~1.005x) — model is matmul-bound (non-matmul ops ~0.4% of runtime per profiler); op-count reduction and numerical equivalence are the verified claims.
INT8 lost no accuracy on this small MLP (+0.01 pp, 9810 vs 9809 correct); deeper nets typically lose more.
INT8 is slower than FP32 on the tiny 128->10 layer (4.7 ms vs 1.9 ms per 9,984-image pass) due to per-row input quantization overhead.
All perf numbers are machine-specific (Apple Silicon, single thread).
